_comment: Proposed Neural Network Games layout, shaped after the PokeRL reference server:
voice at the top, a Meta category, a per-project category, and the private fleet
Run it with --dry-run first. Nothing here is destructive: the script creates what
is missing and never deletes, renames or reorders what exists.
Channels marked announcement need the server to be a Community server; the script
reports and skips them until it is, rather than failing the whole run.
rules and moderator-updates are required by Discord before Community mode can be enabled; create them with a normal run, then re-run with --enable-community.
